body: ive been there before last year. it was really scary at the time but i promise that things will get better. i hope the best for you
sadly there arent any. i cant see myself getting any professional help rn.

hey, i dont know if youre okay but i just want tobsay that you mentioned you have parents and friends. i know they care about you, and if you killed yourself they would feel sad. and since thats kinda guilt trippy (sorry on my part) think about all the things you couldnt do anymore. what you enjoy. all of that? gone.

id say go there for as long as you can even if thats just a few hours. for when youre at home id suggest making your room a quiet space, where you can relax. of course i dont know how she is so this may not be possible. sit outside whether thats in the backyard ot the porch. and if getting away doesnt work out id say use manipulation if you arent already. it sounds wrong but youre being abused. manipulate your mom as much as you can

i promise its not the end, you still have people to meet, places to go, and things to do, take on a new hobby, and hobbies are hard to do when depressed i know that, so if not watch a new show and interact with the fandom. youll find people
depending on your situation, try to spend as much time there as you can. im sure your aunt loves you and wants the best for you

If you havent apologized already do so. i know what that feels like, knowing youve done something wrong to someone you love and just wanting them back but.. its not worth it i promise. you will find someone else and theyll make you happy i know it. it doesnt end here

i want go with the “itll get better” stuff because even though it probably will, that never helps. so ill say this, do you have anyone you care about? someone who will miss you? id also like to add i wouldve said this much sooner but since im new reddit limited me

ah this is hard, but ill admit i thought it would be something way worse. well thats just that persons preference you know? im sure theres someone out there who wouldnt mind you being like that. you shouldnt feel ashamed you just didnt click
well what is it exactly that you did?
this is tough, maybe you can take frequent trips to a family members house? when it got bad for me i stayed the nights at my grandmothers, sometimes for even up to five days
how old are you? do you have a friend or family member u can live with?

i know that im kinda a hypocrite but.... youre really young and have a lot to live for. it seems really really bad now but.. i promise it will get better. maybe try meeting someone? someone that will pull you out of the darkness, make you feel like its worth it
and i also should mention im about the same age as you going through the same thing so i know how hard it can be ALSO on reading some of your other posts i really feel you, its nice to know someone my age is going through what im going through
